issue_title: [Bug] Todo.from_dict silently truncates float id values without warning or validation

triage.root_cause: Python's int() truncates floats toward zero without error. Line 70 in todo.py converts float id values silently, causing data loss.
risk_points: Silent data corruption from float ID truncation
Misleading comment claiming validation that doesn't validate floats
Gap in test coverage for float id handling
verification_targets: Error message mentions 'id must be an integer'

implementation.description: Added explicit float validation before int() conversion using isinstance check and is_integer() method
